game.title: Las Vegas Raiders at New York Jets

lede: Las Vegas Raiders carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#25 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it New York Jets −0.5 with a fair total of 43.0 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Las Vegas Raiders run offence vs New York Jets run defence, which sits −0.240 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
